# DLLs that must be in Assets/Packages for the Bonsai workflows in this project. Checked by
# Installer/BonsaiDllCheck.cs.
#
# GENERATED by Installer/RequiredDllsGenerator.cs from the assemblies each workflow declares and what
# those reference in turn. It is rewritten when a workflow changes, after "Consolidate packages", and
# from Bonsai > Update RequiredDlls.txt. Edit only the section at the end, which is kept as written.
#
# None of these are in git (Assets/Packages is gitignored), so a fresh clone gets them from a Bonsai
# install: install the packages below in Bonsai, then select Assets/Bonsai/BonsaiInstaller.asset and
# click "Consolidate packages".
#
# A missing DLL does not stop the workflow from loading. Bonsai swaps every node from that
# assembly for a proxy with the same type name and no properties, so the workflow starts but those
# nodes do nothing. The only symptom is an error like
# "Bonsai.IO.CsvWriter has no settable property FileName".
#
# Versions are assembly versions (major.minor.build); a DLL at another version is a warning, not an
# error. Updates after a workflow changes keep the versions listed here. Consolidate packages and the
# menu item take the versions in Assets/Packages.
#
# <dll>                               <version>  <needed by>

# Used directly by the workflows
Bonsai.Arduino.dll                    2.9.0      arduino-blink.bonsai
Bonsai.Core.dll                       2.9.2      the Unity bridge, arduino-blink.bonsai, fails.bonsai, finishes.bonsai, hooks-demo.bonsai, 2 more workflows
Bonsai.Scripting.Expressions.dll      2.10.0     arduino-blink.bonsai, fails.bonsai
Bonsai.Windows.Input.dll              2.9.2      arduino-blink.bonsai

# Dependencies of the above
Bonsai.System.dll                     2.9.2      Bonsai.Arduino
System.Linq.Dynamic.Core.dll          1.7.1      Bonsai.Scripting.Expressions
System.Reactive.Core.dll              2.2.5      Bonsai.Arduino, Bonsai.Core, Bonsai.Scripting.Expressions, Bonsai.System, Bonsai.Windows.Input, System.Reactive.Linq, System.Reactive.PlatformServices
System.Reactive.Interfaces.dll        2.2.5      Bonsai.Arduino, Bonsai.Core, Bonsai.System, Bonsai.Windows.Input, System.Reactive.Core, System.Reactive.Linq, System.Reactive.PlatformServices
System.Reactive.Linq.dll              2.2.5      Bonsai.Arduino, Bonsai.Core, Bonsai.Scripting.Expressions, Bonsai.System, Bonsai.Windows.Input, System.Reactive.PlatformServices
System.Reactive.PlatformServices.dll  2.2.5      Bonsai.Core, Bonsai.System
